cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Win the Smaller Concession
cards.instruction: Get one small surrender, then use its logic to make the larger claim harder to defend.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll sort this windowsill. Can my little basil plant stay in the sunny corner?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One little pot. I need room to open the window.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll keep the handle clear. If basil can have sun, the parsley beside it will need some too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll put both in one trough and do the watering. You still get your handle, and neither herb has to die in the hall.

reason: Use a concrete handle constraint and one-container compromise; A stretches one-plant permission by arguing equal sunlight while taking on maintenance.
